basics.name: Rosmar Alejandra Mendoza Canchica
basics.label: Technical Project Manager | PMP® Fundamentals | Agile & IT Delivery
basics.summary: Systems Engineer certified by PMI (PMP® Intro & Fundamentals) with a strong software engineering background and experience leading technology initiatives at MercadoLibre, Fintech, and multinational banking (Scotiabank). Expert in orchestrating cross-functional teams using Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), managing software delivery cycles, ensuring 99%+ SLA compliance, and bridging business requirements with technical architecture.

work.name: MercadoLibre
work.summary: Active participation in delivering critical microservices at massive scale, combining technical execution with operational coordination and incident management at one of Latin America's largest platforms.
highlights: Coordinated delivery of microservices and RESTful APIs in Golang, Java, and Python, ensuring technical alignment with team goals and 99%+ SLA compliance for millions of users.
Led on-call operations management and production incident response, prioritizing and escalating critical issues to minimize platform impact.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) and actively contributed to continuous process improvement within the development team.
Completed MercadoLibre's Backend Bootcamp, gaining deep technical knowledge to effectively communicate requirements between engineering teams and product stakeholders.
Integrated AI tools (Cursor, Claude) into team workflows, boosting productivity and reducing delivery timelines.

work.name: Mo Technologies
work.position: Support L2 — Incident Management & SLA Compliance
work.summary: Level 2 incident management, strict SLA compliance, and coordination with development teams for production issue resolution.
highlights: Managed and prioritized Level 2 technical incidents in Jira Service Desk, complying with strict SLAs and reporting compliance metrics to leadership.
Coordinated communication between support, development, and operations teams for agile resolution of critical production incidents.
Identified recurring error patterns and proposed process improvements that reduced Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).

work.name: Mo Technologies
work.summary: Backend service development and delivery for financial products, collaborating with product, QA, and operations teams.
highlights: Coordinated delivery of RESTful APIs in Python (FastAPI, Django) for credit products, ensuring quality and sprint deadline compliance.
Designed data models and optimized SQL queries in PostgreSQL, presenting technical proposals to stakeholders for architecture change approvals.
Managed AWS and Webhook integrations, coordinating with infrastructure and operations teams for production deployments.
Documented technical processes and generated progress reports for product team and leadership visibility.

work.name: Scotiabank GBS
work.position: System Access Analyst — IT Governance & Reporting
work.summary: IT governance, centralized access management, and control dashboard creation for auditing and decision-making at a multinational bank.
highlights: Managed corporate user permissions and identities, handling onboarding, offboarding, and modification processes with Active Directory and Microsoft Office 365.
Built interactive KPI dashboards in Power BI to audit access, provide operational visibility, and support security team decision-making.
Coordinated with global teams on role and access configurations for corporate applications built on .NET technology, ensuring regulatory compliance.
Documented and improved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for identity and access management.

work.name: Intexus
work.summary: IT operations management, infrastructure monitoring, and help desk administration.
highlights: Supervised technology infrastructure availability, managing operational SLAs and ticket resolution via Jira Help Desk.
Generated performance and availability reports for management decision-making.
